tasks.symptom: `nx.single_source_shortest_path_length(nx.path_graph(4), 0)` returns `{0: 0, 1: 2, 2: 4, 3: 6}`; every unweighted distance is doubled.
`nx.dijkstra_path_length` sometimes returns a longer distance than the true shortest path: when a node is first discovered through an expensive edge, a cheaper route found later is ignored.
`nx.connected_components` splits large components: on `nx.path_graph(5)` it yields several small sets instead of one set with all 5 nodes, so `nx.number_connected_components` is wrong.
`nx.triangles` and `nx.clustering` give wrong values when the graph has self-loops; self-loops should be ignored but now change the results.
`list(nx.topological_sort(G))` is wrong for DAGs where a node has a single parent: on `nx.DiGraph([(1, 2), (2, 3)])` it raises or omits nodes instead of returning `[1, 2, 3]`.
`nx.bellman_ford_path_length` raises `NetworkXUnbounded` ("Negative cycle detected") on ordinary weighted graphs that have no negative cycles at all.
